{{Quote|Master Kenobi has taken the Jixuan desert, so the southern hemisphere is ours.|Mace Windu|audio=JixuanDesert-LoR.flac|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>}}
The '''Jixuan desert''' was an area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

==History==
During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] reported that General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had captured it, meaning that the southern hemisphere of Ryloth was theirs.
